text:
Ibrahim A: Heads-up: multiple postmortem actions are aging with unclear verifiers. I propose a short weekly "remediation triage" (15m) focused only on open PM actions: owner, ETA, blocker, verifier. IC on duty facilitates.

Lena V: Agree. Keep it strict: max 6 items per meeting so we don't run over. Also require remediation_type tag (code/process/infra) in the tracker.

Omar K: Can incidents-bot DM owners 48h before due date and 2d after if overdue? DM + one channel summary should be enough noise control.

Ibrahim A: Yes to bot DMs. Also require a named verifier before an item can be marked closed. No verifier -> item auto-flagged during weekly triage.

Lena V: For rotation, IC facilitation feels light. Let's give IC a 1-paragraph checklist: start, run 15m, update tracker rows in-place, tag any missing owners, and note escalations.

Omar K: For recurring patterns, monthly trend doc with top 5 remediation tags and a small heatmap would help prioritize system fixes vs band-aids. I can prototype a query.

oncall-bot: Reminder created: weekly "Remediation triage" Mon 09:20-09:35. Tracker updated: columns added: verifier, remediation_type, due_date_reminder.

Ibrahim A: Action items: 1) Omar -> prototype monthly trend query (due Fri). 2) Lena -> draft 1-paragraph IC checklist (due Thu). 3) Ibrahim -> wire bot DM reminders and stale-flag policy (90d) (due Mon).

Lena V: I'll keep the checklist minimal. Also :+1: on a standard one-line note format for weeklies: `item_id — owner (ETA) — blocker — verifier`.

Omar K: Will post the prototype query link here when ready.

Ibrahim A: Thanks team. I'll schedule the recuring meeting and add the checklist link to the tracker.
